dYdX is a decentralized cryptocurrency derivatives exchange that offers perpetual futures trading. dYdX operates on public blockchains and settles trades through smart contracts without a central intermediary. dYdX has used a layer 2 scaling architecture built on StarkWare's StarkEx system. dYdX has also operated its own blockchain application chain built on the Cosmos SDK.

Filecoin is a decentralized storage network built on a public blockchain. Filecoin uses a native token, FIL, to reward storage providers and pay for storage. Filecoin verifies stored data through cryptographic proofs such as proof-of-replication and proof-of-spacetime. Filecoin was developed by Protocol Labs.

Level Finance is a decentralized finance protocol that offers perpetual trading. Level Finance operates on the BNB Chain. Level Finance uses the LVL token as its native token.

Perpetual Protocol is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange. Perpetual Protocol uses a virtual automated market maker model for pricing trades. Perpetual Protocol uses the PERP token as its native token. Perpetual Protocol has been deployed on Ethereum layer 2 networks.

Gains Network is a decentralized leveraged trading platform that offers trading on forex, commodities, crypto and stocks. Gains Network operates through its gTrade application on layer 2 networks such as Arbitrum and Polygon. Gains Network uses the GNS token as its native token.
